//: Desktop shell only. NOT part of `npm run typecheck` — see docs/ELECTRON_PLAN.md §2:
adding a fifth invocation to the root script would fail the Pages CI job on
`TS2307: Cannot find module 'electron'` unless deploy.yml also gained
`npm ci --prefix desktop`, and deploy.yml is the file that must not change.
Run it with `npm run desktop:typecheck` from the repo root.
`include` is the security boundary, exactly as server/tsconfig.json is:
the desktop shell may not import game code. It serves dist/ as opaque bytes.
